kind: pre-development metric-independent fresh phase-state selection rule
success_acceptance: environment task-success predicate only; first 12 ascending frozen seeds per task

executable_state_requirement.gripper: copied from the nominal generator chunk and never perturbed

contact_anchor: first current observable relevant-contact true index
contact_absent_fallback: argmax one-step positive observable task-progress increment; recorded as fallback

desired_indices.free_space: earliest executable no-contact index no later than floor(anchor/3)
desired_indices.pre_contact: latest executable no-contact index strictly before anchor
desired_indices.contact_onset: nearest executable index to anchor, preferring the exact false-to-true transition
desired_indices.post_contact: earliest executable index strictly after anchor, preferring current contact true

tie_break: smallest absolute distance to desired index, then smallest timestep
uniqueness: four distinct timesteps per trajectory; if a preferred pool is empty, nearest globally executable unused index is used and labeled fallback
shortage: never clip, synthesize, change the accepted success list, or substitute a demonstration; record BLOCKED_NO_FRESH_TRAJECTORIES if the frozen supply cannot produce 12 complete trajectories per task
